beats.say: The Hunger Games returns to cinemas with a prequel set 24 years earlier.
Sunrise on the Reaping hits the United States on Friday 20 November 2026.
This story follows the Second Quarter Quell, also known as the 50th Hunger Games.
Joseph Zada stars as a young Haymitch Abernathy alongside Mckenna Grace as Maysilee Donner.
The film features a huge cast including Ralph Fiennes, Glenn Close, and Elle Fanning.
Seeing how Haymitch survived his own games changes everything you know about the mentor.
The full list of tributes and stars is in Part 2.

facts: The Hunger Games Sunrise on the Reaping is scheduled to be released in the United States on November 20, 2026.
The film is set in the world of Panem 24 years before the events of The Hunger Games.
The 50th Hunger Games is also known as the Second Quarter Quell.
Joseph Zada plays young Haymitch Abernathy.
Mckenna Grace will play tribute Maysilee Donner in the film.
The cast includes Jesse Plemons, Ralph Fiennes, Glenn Close, Kieran Culkin, Elle Fanning, and Maya Hawke.
